13	# Feature: Skills availability
14	
15	## Feature
16	
17	Feature: Skills availability
18	  An agent of the lead shop performing an activity that operates
19	  through a process definition
20	  can load the approved definition of that activity at its point of
21	  work, through a governed channel that is itself a defined process
22	  with its own check,
23	  so that the shop stops drifting from its approved definitions:
24	  every approved process loadable, zero divergence, the gap held
25	  closed by a repeatable check.
26	
27	## Contributors
28	
29	Owning shop, per scenario — from the initiative's Decomposition
30	section, which names no Bounded Context: source definitions, the
31	generator, and the delivery point all sit in the lead shop's own tree.
32	
33	- *an approved process definition is loadable at the point of work* — shopsystem-product (the lead shop)
34	- *a definition that does not stand approved yields no loadable skill* — shopsystem-product (the lead shop)
35	- *divergence between a loadable skill and its definition's rendering is detected* — shopsystem-product (the lead shop)
36	- *an approved process without a loadable skill is reported* — shopsystem-product (the lead shop)
37	- *a hand-diverged skill is reconciled* — shopsystem-product (the lead shop)
38	- *the check passes clean when every approved process is available* — shopsystem-product (the lead shop)
39	
40	No usability acceptance criteria and no accessibility criteria are due for these scenarios: the initiative's For whom section names no interaction type — the outcome is consumed inside the executing agent's context load; no core task carries it. (designer, 2026-09-02)
41	
42	## Interaction types
43	
44	None — the outcome is consumed inside the executing agent's context
45	load; no core task carries it (the initiative's For whom section).
46	
47	## Scenarios
48	
49	```gherkin
50	Feature: Skills availability
51	  An agent of the lead shop performing an activity that operates
52	  through a process definition
53	  can load the approved definition of that activity at its point of
54	  work, through a governed channel that is itself a defined process
55	  with its own check,
56	  so that the shop stops drifting from its approved definitions:
57	  every approved process loadable, zero divergence, the gap held
58	  closed by a repeatable check.
59	
60	  @feature:feat-skills-availability @hash:00c23fd484a5
61	  Scenario: an approved process definition is loadable at the point of work
62	    Given a process definition that stands approved
63	    When the rendering process runs
64	    Then a loadable skill for that definition exists at the agent's load point, matching the generated rendering
65	
66	  @feature:feat-skills-availability @hash:0a67495f76e6
67	  Scenario: a definition that does not stand approved yields no loadable skill
68	    Given a process definition that does not stand approved
69	    When the rendering process runs
70	    Then no skill for that definition is loadable at the agent's load point
71	
72	  @feature:feat-skills-availability @hash:e54f89c25bbf
73	  Scenario: divergence between a loadable skill and its definition's rendering is detected
74	    Given a loadable skill whose text differs from its definition's rendering
75	    When the check runs
76	    Then the check reports the divergence, naming the process whose skill diverged
77	
78	  @feature:feat-skills-availability @hash:4a07b9bbc96d
79	  Scenario: an approved process without a loadable skill is reported
80	    Given an approved process definition with no loadable skill at the agent's load point
81	    When the check runs
82	    Then the check reports that process as not available to the agent
83	
84	  @feature:feat-skills-availability @hash:9a627fe3ab4c
85	  Scenario: a hand-diverged skill is reconciled
86	    Given a loadable skill edited by hand away from its definition's rendering
87	    When the rendering process runs
88	    Then the skill the agent loads matches the definition's rendering
89	
90	  @feature:feat-skills-availability @hash:de2bd01c0f18
91	  Scenario: the check passes clean when every approved process is available
92	    Given every approved process definition with a loadable skill at the agent's load point matching its rendering

# Initiative: Skills availability

## Framing

Originator (product authority, 2026-09-02, through the operational
contract): "We have a number of processes, guidelines, etc defined in
basis, but they are not placed where an agent would make use of them.
The skills directory is in the wrong place and incomplete." Scope, in
the originator's words: "This is very constrained and limited to
making sure skills are available to the agent. This should itself be a
process." And the stakes: "This session is showing that we are already
drifting away from the principles and need to start implementing
consistency in the process and tools."

Problem: the shop's approved process definitions cannot be loaded by
the agent performing the activity, and making them loadable belongs to
no process. Outcome: an agent performing an
activity operates from the approved definition of that activity,
loaded at its point of work through a governed channel that is itself
a defined process with its own check.

## For whom

The lead shop: every agent activity that operates through a process
definition. Measure: approved processes whose definition the executing
agent can load through a governed channel. Now: 1 of 16, and that one
hand-diverged from its source. Target: every approved process, zero
divergence, the gap held closed by a repeatable check. Interaction
types: none — the outcome is consumed inside the executing agent's
context load; no core task carries it.

## Appetite

One working session of the lead shop. No-gos, each with its reason:

- Importing skills from the frozen corpus (brief-030's 38-skill plan)
  — the authority ruled it out; migration stays demand-pull and lands
  through whatever this initiative makes available.
- Delivering guidelines into authoring contexts — the glossary places
  guidelines in the artifact process; the observed gap is filed
  separately (lead-m2o7h).
- Role definitions, beyond any part that is itself skill-shaped — the
  authority excepted them.
- Retrieval, relevance, or knowledge-graph work — parked as premature
  on lead-jwsl1.

## Feasibility and usability

Feasible. The generating channel exists and runs:
`basis/tools/compile_process.py` regenerated the
`stakeholder-presentation` skill cleanly, and its `source-digest` makes
divergence mechanically checkable — the reachable copy's stale digest
confirms the hand-drift. Ten of sixteen approved processes already have
generated renderings in `basis/skills/`; the rest compile from the same
format. What remains is placement and a defined process with its check —
within the appetite. (architect, 2026-09-02)

No usability attachment due: no interaction type named — the outcome
loads inside the executing agent's context; no core task carries it.
(designer, 2026-09-02)

## Decomposition

None — no Bounded Context is touched. Source definitions, the
generator, and the delivery point (`.claude/skills/`) all sit in the
lead shop's tree; no contract on `main` is relied on. Cross-context
flow: none.

## Features

[feat-skills-availability](../features/feat-skills-availability.md) — draft.
